description:
The cheapest module in the arc: ~25 functions, ZERO allocating externs.

runtime.fz already declares keyword() and keyword(t). Elixir's keyword.ex is 513 code
lines and every BIF it touches (:lists.keyfind x8, keymember x4, keytake, keydelete,
map, filter, foldl, sort, member, reverse x11) is a plain fz recursion over a list of
2-tuples.

Core: new/0,1 get/2,3 fetch/2 fetch!/2 put/3 put_new/3 delete/2 delete_first/2
has_key?/2 keys/1 values/1 get_values/2 merge/2,3 update/4 update!/3 pop/2,3 take/2
drop/2 keyword?/1 validate/2 validate!/2

Needs only type-annotated dispatch (for keyword?/1) and panic for the ! variants.
Blocked on fz-5xp.4 -- Keyword.get/2 is currently hijacked into a map index.
title: Keyword module
